payload.input: 0.9::artist:miv4t::, 0.6::artist:mochizuki_kei::, artist:ashima (roro046), artist:akinashi yuu, 0.6::artist:akakura::, 0.5::artist:lm7 (op-center)::, simple background, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres; A squat compact tracked bomb-disposal robot redesigned as an armed urban security UGV. Two stubby rubber tracks, each only slightly longer than the central chassis, support a low rugged dark-grey industrial equipment box. The robot is wider than it is tall. A small short-barrel automatic weapon mounted on top on a simple bracket, next to a camera sensor ball on a short mast. Visible mechanical linkages between short tracks and body, side maintenance hatch, subtle orange industrial paint accents. No cockpit or passenger compartment. All components tightly packed together. Entire standalone machine seen in a clear high three-quarter view, diffuse frontal studio light, transparent background. Realistic compact ground robot proportions, not a manned military vehicle.
